title: A FRAUD but NOT charged-off loan IGNORES the fraud flag and credits INCOME_FROM_BUY_DOWN for a buy-down fee amortization (loan 8 L461: CREDIT account 24 17.58, DEBIT account 22 17.58)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the TWO-LEG journal entry a BUY_DOWN_FEE_AMORTIZATION transaction posts on a loan whose fraud flag is TRUE but is NOT charged off, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES) at the amortization transaction L461. request.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's amortization transaction id 461 (type loanTransactionType.buyDownFeeAmortization): interestPortion 17.58 -> "1758" and feeChargesPortion 0 -> "0" minor units. The loan is NOT charged off and NOT written off but IS fraud, so request.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal.fraud is true and charged_off / written_off are absent. request.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal.accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request create-request-LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES.json: incomeFromBuyDownAccountId 24, deferredIncomeLiabilityAccountId 22, writeOffAccountId 15, chargeOffExpenseAccountId 18, chargeOffFraudExpenseAccountId 16. expect.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L461 legs in id order from the journal-entries sweep: id 946 entryType CREDIT glAccountId 24 amount 17.58 and id 947 DEBIT glAccountId 22 amount 17.58. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: fraud is read ONLY in the charged-off arm, so a loan marked fraud that is NOT charged off credits INCOME_FROM_BUY_DOWN (24), exactly like the normal observation; a port that branches on fraud unconditionally would credit CHARGE_OFF_FRAUD_EXPENSE (16) and fail. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: the charged-off and written-off arms and a positive fee portion (zero here); the buy-down-fee CLASSIFICATION and charge-off-REASON branches (not observed, no input). Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
